onClick: {{ (async () => { const reason = inpCompanyNotesReason.text.trim(); if (!reason) return showAlert('Provide a reason for changing notes.', 'warning'); try { await qSaveCompanyIdentityNotes.run({ notes: inpCompanyNotes.text, reason }); await qCompanyIdentityNotes.run(); showAlert('Identity notes saved.', 'success'); } catch(e) { showAlert('Unable to save identity notes: ' + (e?.message || e), 'error'); } })() }}
